name: @red-cup-engineering/witness-journal-coherence
description: Computes the coherence judgement between two wire-form readings of the same witness or ordered witness log — a settled judgement over witnesses, never a stored field. Built on the generic round-trip check in @red-cup-engineering/wire-form-round-trip-check; extracted from relating's ledger module, where the two capabilities were fused.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
